title: MCP contract shared types
description: Shared types for the MCP tool contracts: IDs, keys, dates, paging, labels, principals and the engine meaning lists. Field names follow document 20, section 3.3. Configuration references travel as keys. Operational references travel as IDs.
$comment: WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 1). The engine meaning lists below are fixed values the engine reads. Every label stays configurable and maps to one meaning. Document 20, section 2.4.

guid.description: An Entra object ID or application ID, written as a GUID.

id.description: The ID of an operational row. Configuration rows never travel as IDs, only as keys.

key.description: A configuration key. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 1 to 64 characters, starting with a letter. Document 20, section 3.2.

toolName.description: A tool name: lowercase snake_case, verb first.

dateTime.description: An ISO date and time in UTC, ending in Z.

reasonCode.description: An engine reason code: lowercase, dot-separated, never reused. Document 25, section 7.

guidelineNumber.description: A guideline number, such as G17 (C39 Guideline).

clientRequestId.description: The caller's own ID for this request. A retry with the same value returns the first result and writes nothing new. A reused value with a different payload returns conflict.

validateOnly.description: True runs every rule and returns what would be written, without writing. Lets an AI client show the person the result first.

top.description: Page size. The server caps it at the mcp-page-size-max setting (100 by default).

skipToken.description: The token from the previous page. It encodes the query, not server state.

nextSkipToken.description: Pass this value as skipToken to get the next page. Absent on the last page.

labelledKey.description: A configuration row by key, with its label.

displayLabel.description: A name to show people. Refreshed when seen.

directoryObject.description: An Entra object by ID, with a label. Read live, never a copy of the directory.

displayLabel.description: A name to show people. An erased person shows as former user.

principalRef.description: A Principal Reference (O05): an Entra object ID with a label.

label.description: The label from the client-app value list, such as Claude Code.

clientApp.description: The MCP client or application that made the call.

statusValue.description: A status label and its engine meaning, such as { label: "Draft", meaning: "draft" }. Logic reads the meaning, never the label.

statusMeaning.description: Any status engine meaning. Each entity uses its own list.

recordStatusMeaning.description: Record status meaning, for an Intake Request (O07) or a Change Request (O11).

decisionStatusMeaning.description: Decision status meaning, for a Decision (O09).

registrationStatusMeaning.description: Registration status meaning, for a Business Application (O02).

approvalOutcomeMeaning.description: Approval outcome meaning, for an Approval Record (O10).

documentStatusMeaning.description: Document status meaning, for a Document Link (O19). Missing is computed and never stored.

claimStatusMeaning.description: Claim status meaning, for a Claim (O23).

deploymentResultMeaning.description: Deployment result meaning, for a Deployment Record (O14).

reviewStatusMeaning.description: Review status meaning, for a Review (O21).

draftStatusMeaning.description: Draft status meaning, for a Configuration Draft (C46).

lifecycleMeaning.description: Lifecycle meaning of a Lifecycle Stage (C12).

actorKindMeaning.description: Actor kind meaning (C38). It comes from the entry point and the token, never from a caller field.

principalKind.description: Principal kind (O05). Only a user can approve. Roles bind only to groups.

requirementKind.description: Requirement kind (C14): how the engine tests a gate requirement.

directoryState.description: Directory State (O05), as last read from Entra by the owner check.

key.description: The key of the group. Null for rows with no value, such as an application with no tier yet.

approvalNeeded.description: One approval a decision needs, resolved from the single most specific Approval Rule group (C32). Exactly one of approverRoleKey and approverOwnerRoleKey.

minimumCount.description: How many counted approvals the rule needs. Zero only for the locked list the engine may accept without a card.

ownerAssignmentId.description: Pass it as endAssignmentId to propose_owner_change.

deputyFor.description: The main assignment this deputy covers.

startOn.description: When the assignment starts. Null while it waits for its ownership decision.

endOn.description: When it ends. Null while current.

ownershipDecisionId.description: The decision that made the assignment.

ownerAssignment.description: One principal holding one owner role for one application (O06).

ownerGap.description: An owner role with no holder or no deputy.

idempotencyKey.description: The sender's retry key, such as run ID plus stage plus attempt. A retry with the same key returns the existing record and writes nothing new (I-189).

linkKindKey.description: A link kind of the evidence category.

url.description: Opens the proof. Checked against the link kind's Url Pattern and the forbidden URL patterns.

evidenceInput.description: One link to proof held elsewhere. It becomes an Evidence Link (O20).

outsideWindow.description: Finished outside the linked change's window.

otherPath.description: The route is not an allowed route of the target's change path.

missingApproval.description: No authorization where the policy expects one.

aiOnlyCodeApproval.description: The only reported code approval came from an AI. It never counts as authorization.

deploymentFlags.description: The flags the engine computes on a Deployment Record (O14). Callers never set them.

approvalsSummary.description: Counts of the approval records of one decision.

decisionSubjectKind.description: The kind of record a Decision (O09) is about.

changeManagementMode.description: Change management mode (D-08): built in, or linked to the client's ITSM tool.

deploymentRouteMeaning.description: Deployment route meaning (C36). Set by the engine from the entry point.

codeApprovalKind.description: Who approved the code merge, as reported. Evidence only, never authorization.

standardChangeConditionKind.description: A condition kind of a Standard Change Model (C21), document 25, OP-12.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of a snapshot, as lowercase hex.

entityKey.description: An entity key: the kebab-case form of a logical entity name, such as gate-policy.

keyPath.description: A configuration key, or for a child row the parent key, a slash, then the child key.
